summary.title: Professional Summary
summary.desc: My journey in the area of systems development began in 2021, when I enrolled in the Computer Science course. Since then I have been passionate about programming and software development. More specifically, I am interested in topics such as programming languages, algorithm development, software engineering, distributed systems and artificial intelligence. I consider myself adventurously curious, I like to develop new skills and refine the ones I already have.

desc.1: Development of critical and high-availability systems for the financial ecosystem, focusing on instant payment solutions and architecture modernization.
desc.2: Key Deliveries: Development and maintenance of features for Pix Automático and Pix QR Code, ensuring performance and security in large-scale transactions.
desc.3: Technical leadership in refactoring administrative panels, migrating legacy architectures to Spring Boot (backend) and Angular with Microfrontends (frontend).
desc.4: Development of scalable REST APIs using Quarkus and Rest-Client, integrating distributed systems in mission-critical environments.
desc.5: Implementation of unit tests (JUnit) and load/performance tests (JMeter), ensuring application resilience.
desc.6: Continuous monitoring via Grafana and Graylog, with deployment and orchestration of containers via RedHat OpenShift, Docker, and Azure DevOps.
desc.7: Stack: Java (Quarkus, Spring Boot), Microservices, REST APIs, Angular, TypeScript, PrimeNG, Microfrontends, OpenShift, Azure DevOps, Git, Docker, Grafana, Graylog, GitHub Copilot, IntelliJ, VS Code.

g1.title: Computer Science Bsc
g1.desc: During the foundational cycle (2 years), I studied core subjects including programming languages, data structures and algorithms, machine learning, computer networks, databases, operating systems and hardware infrastructure, theory of computation, and compilers. In the professional cycle (2.5 years), I specialized in advanced topics such as distributed systems, software architecture, neural networks, and deep learning. I also gained expertise in data warehousing and subject-oriented databases, while being introduced to emerging fields like quantum computing and responsible AI. Additionally, I had the privilege of serving as a teaching assistant for the discrete mathematics course for two years, further honing my academic and instructional skills. My graduation project is in the field of Process Minning and Clustering.
